# Builders @ Envoy

## The workplace runs on what we build

From visitor sign-in to space scheduling, our team builds the systems behind safer, smarter workplaces. Get to know the people doing the work.

[See open EPD roles](https://envoy.com/jobs)

![Builders @ Envoy](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/6a286e1308255f68a74cd37e_Builders%40Envoy_logo-260609.png)

## Meet the builders

The people behind Envoy on what they're building, what they've shipped, and what they've learned taking ideas from concept to production. Read their latest below.

[![Smiling woman with long dark hair wearing a white puff-sleeve top and layered necklaces, standing in front of tall green grass.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6509fe179d7033a278a05268/6aad5802a6257941952909f4_joyce-headshot.png)\\

Joyce Chu\\
\\
September 28, 2026\\

**Designing Envoy Response for zero hesitation** \\
\\
When every second matters, good design gets out of the way. Here’s how we built Envoy Response to reduce noise, anticipate decisions, and help people act faster in an emergency.](https://envoy.com/builders/designing-envoy-response-for-zero-hesitation)
